summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Go Global Now MVP. All 6 backend pytest cases pass (root, stats, inquiry CRUD+list, consultation CRUD+list, chat with Claude, chat history, inquiry validation). Frontend: Home, Programs, Destinations, About, Contact pages load. Multi-step inquiry form submits and persists to DB (verified via API). Consultation booking with shadcn calendar + time picker shows success toast and saves. WhatsApp float link correct (wa.me/61280029276). Admin /admin page lists inquiries (3) and consultations (2) with stats. Chat widget Claude integration works (returns proper study advice).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Made with Emergent' floating badge in the bottom-right corner overlaps the chat-toggle button, intercepting normal user clicks. Toggle only opens when clicked via JS/keyboard. Increase z-index of chat-toggle (and reposition slightly above the badge area) so it remains clickable in production.

integration_issues.issue: Only program buttons render testids on step 2; preferred_destination and english_level are saved as empty strings in DB when user proceeds via inquiry-next. Either the destination/english inputs are on a later sub-step that the test missed OR the fields are not bound in step 2. Verify Step 2 includes destination + english selectors and they bind to state before advancing.

action_items: Raise z-index of [data-testid=chat-toggle] above the Made-with-Emergent badge OR shift it left/up so the badge does not intercept clicks.

Verify multi-step inquiry form step 2 captures preferred_destination and english_level (currently saved as empty strings). Likely destination/english are on a sub-pane within step 2 that requires additional UI; ensure values bind before clicking Next.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses asyncio.create_task for Resend emails — good, fails gracefully when RESEND_API_KEY is empty (logged warning, inquiry still saved).
All Mongo reads correctly project {_id:0}; no ObjectId leakage.
Pydantic EmailStr validation returns 422 for invalid emails — verified.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_Playwright inquiry and 1 TEST_Cons consultation via UI; pytest creates additional TEST_ records each run (not auto-cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_api.py -v`. Chat widget toggle is blocked by Made-with-Emergent badge in production preview; if reproducing, click via JS or increase z-index. Inquiry form step 2 currently only exposes program buttons via testid — destination/english fields need investigation.
rca of the issue: Chat-toggle click blocked: z-index/positioning conflict with platform 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay at fixed bottom-right. Repro: visit homepage, click whatsapp-style chat bubble at bottom-right — nothing happens. Mitigation: bump chat-toggle z-index (e.g., z-[9999]) and/or offset bottom position by ~60px.
